notes.title: 🎮 New Game Name 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey, guys! 👋

We're changing the name of the game to "Keyboard Crush", originally "Rocket Blaster". The name had some conflicts, so we decided to change the actual name of the game after all. Better to change it now than later. I hope this name will describe our game better. Thank you for your understanding.

[b]The name of the game in the game will change after the new update![/b]

Best Regards,
© AltexGamesStudios
